channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 5
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 5 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 5: The City's Legistar pages list the amended development…
item.description: The City's Legistar pages list the amended development agreement (File 260724) and its zoning ordinance (File 260770) as approved by the Mayor and enacted on October 13, 2026 (Enactment Nos. 208-26 and 209-26). Four lines in this record still said the package was not shown as enacted, or that the adopted 85 ft limit applied 'until then'. They now say it was enacted; both ordinances say 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a) and File 260724, in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment), which makes November 13, 2026 the effective date by our count, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text; the heights and uses in the enacted text are not yet checked against this record, so the record's height and use figures still show the adopted limits. The record's timeline now has an entry for the Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes), before the Mayor's approval. Source: SF Board of Supervisors, Legistar, BOS File 260724 and File 260770 (https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127453&GUID=CC4AC1DD-BF51-4585-86E8-0A5D44AA3745); Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachments: https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063745&GUID=68B0CE5F-84C2-4368-BF8D-EEA7D8B92E55 and https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063746&GUID=9EA91A49-BBF9-4471-9EA9-6E7BD33A4353.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 5: The City's Legistar pages for the amended development…
item.description: The City's Legistar pages for the amended development agreement (File 260724) and its zoning ordinance (File 260770) list both as passed and enacted on October 13, 2026 (Mayor approved; enactment numbers 208-26 and 209-26). item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Mayor approves the Amended and Restated… (Oct 13, 2026)
item.description: Mayor approves the Amended and Restated Development Agreement (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): Legistar lists both as 'Status: Passed' with 'Final action: 10/13/2026', 'Enactment date: 10/13/2026' and enactment numbers 208-26 (File 260724) and 209-26 (File 260770), and a history row '10/13/2026 ... Mayor ... APPROVED' for each. The Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes) is the previous entry on this timeline. October 13, 2026 is the enactment date, from the Clerk of the Board's listing (page read October 14 and again October 17, 2026); it is an event date. Both ordinances provide 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a), p. 56 of its 'Leg Final' attachment; File 260724, p. 10 of its attachment); counted from October 13, 2026 that is November 13, 2026, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text. (Oct 13, 2026). Source: SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 5: The 2026 amendment package proposes moving Block 5…
item.description: The 2026 amendment package proposes moving Block 5 from Phase 3 to Phase 2 and adding up to 8 feet of height on residential blocks. It is not shown as enacted, so the adopted 220 ft limit and the 2020 forecast still stand. Source: Planning Commission Resolution No. 21945 with Executive Summary, July 30, 2026 (https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=15807606&GUID=2D132AF3-74D6-4275-8AB9-A23CD4E46247); Potrero Power Station Design for Development, Feb 26, 2020 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Board of Supervisors finally passes the… (Oct 6, 2026)
item.description: Board of Supervisors finally passes the Amended and Restated Development Agreement ordinance (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): the Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachment to each file lists 'October 06, 2026 Board of Supervisors - FINALLY PASSED', 'Ayes: 11 - Chan, Chen, Dorsey, Fielder, Mahmood, Mandelman, Melgar, Sauter, Sherrill, Walton and Wong' (File 260724 attachment pp. 11-12; File 260770 attachment pp. 58-59), and the Clerk's certificate says each ordinance 'was FINALLY PASSED on 10/6/2026 by the Board of Supervisors'. The date is the Board's vote date, an event date. The Legistar history row for 10/6/2026 on each file's web page carries no action text, so the attachment is the source for this entry. The Mayor's approval and enactment followed on October 13, 2026 (next entry). (Oct 6, 2026). Source: SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Block 5's record and map notes no longer treat the…
item.description: Block 5's record and map notes no longer treat the '111' MAX' label on Figure 6.2.3 as a height: it is a dimension line, and the block's height limits are 85 ft (base) and 220 ft. The July 2026 all-PDR / 'small data center' amendment request is no longer marked as expected, and a Sep 18, 2026 Chronicle report that the developer planned to retract the amendment was added. Expected completion is now 2034, from SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table (Phase 3, vertical development 2031-2034), instead of the 2035 whole-project target. The parcel note now says most of the footprint lies within active lot 4175500 (1248 Georgia Ln), sources cite the final D4D instead of a dead 2019 draft link, D4D publishers are shown as SF Planning, and one image is labelled a document, not a rendering. Source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html); San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-07-29 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/one-s-f-s-biggest-developments-changing-plans-22365461.php); San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-09-18 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/sf/article/data-center-waterfront-ai-dogpatch-22438639.php); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn).

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Developer says it never intended a large… (Sep 18, 2026)
item.description: Developer says it never intended a large data center and, per the Chronicle, 'confirmed Friday that the team is planning to retract the amendment' (Sep 18, 2026). Source: San Francisco Chronicle (Laura Waxmann), 2026-09-18.

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Completion expected: SocketSite's October 2020… (~2034)
item.description: Completion expected: SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table lists Block 5 in Phase 3 with vertical development 2031-2034 (Block 5 is not in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list: Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) (~2034). Source: SocketSite, 2020-10-09; SF Planning, 2020-10-07; SF Planning Commission / Planning Department, 2026-07-30.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Developer requests flexibility to build… (~Jul 2026)
item.description: Developer requests flexibility to build all-PDR space on Block 5, including a possible 'small data center' if a future tenant requires it, rather than the entitled residential building (Chronicle, July 29, 2026) (~Jul 2026). Source: San Francisco Chronicle (Laura Waxmann), 2026-07-29.

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 5: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero… (Apr 21, 2020)
item.description: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement covering the adopted Design for Development, whose Land Use Table (Table 3.1.1) lists Block 5; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date (Apr 21, 2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; SF Planning; SF Planning, 2020-02-26.
